source: the documentation of HOOMD-blue (latest (units, md.bond.Harmonic, md.methods.Brownian, md.compute.ThermodynamicQuantities), read on the days their material cards name; the release they document is a row of values_read), as the builder read it; the document is not in this directory

observed.claim: HOOMD-blue adopts no system of units: it follows a self-consistent one on three base units, energy, length and mass, from which time, force and pressure are derived
evidence: Units, sections Base Units and Unit Conversion (mat-20261120-hoomd-7.2.2-units)

observed.claim: md.bond.Harmonic gives each bond the energy U(r) = k (r - r0)^2 / 2, with k the potential constant in energy per length squared and r0 the rest length, set per bond type in params

md.methods.Brownian integrates the overdamped Langevin equation on a particle filter at a temperature kT (energy) with a translational drag coefficient gamma per particle type (mass per time), the random force sized by the fluctuation-dissipation theorem; its error is first order in the time step
evidence: hoomd.md.methods.Brownian, the equations of motion, the parameters and the warning (mat-20261121-hoomd-7.2.2-methods-brownian)

observed.claim: md.compute.ThermodynamicQuantities reports pressure_tensor, six components xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz, each the kinetic sum plus the net virial of the integrator's forces over the volume, in pressure units; under Brownian the velocities are drawn each step at the set temperature

HOOMD-blue computes the virial and the pressure only on steps where a GSD writer or an NPT integrator needs them unless Simulation.always_compute_pressure is set; read between them, pressure_tensor is not a number
evidence: the run adapter's first trial under TMPDIR, every logged component not a number, and its second, finite with the flag set (failure bd-1)

observed.claim: the run adapter, tried under TMPDIR with hoomd from conda-forge, ran Brownian dynamics of Hookean dumbbells and logged the xy, xz and yz components of the pressure tensor with the box volume; passed through autocorrelation_of_series, shear_relaxation_modulus_green_kubo and exponential_decay_fit they gave a relaxation time and a viscosity near the dumbbell relations' for the trial's settings (evidence for the adapter only; no value of it enters a card)
evidence: the adapter's third trial under TMPDIR, result.json and run.log of its run folder

held.item: the comparison of the run's relaxation time and polymer viscosity with the dumbbell's relations
held.reason: the bundle's check measures through one skill and takes no reference a skill computes
